title: Catalog change proposal
description: [CONFIRMED design direction] Declarative owner-approved catalog change consumed only by the offline C9 tool. It contains data, never SQL or executable text. Applying a proposal invalidates the old package manifest until the existing Seal-Package flow reseals the package.

note.description: ASCII audit note. No secret or credential value.

cellValue.description: C9 V1 supports SQLite NULL, INTEGER/bit and TEXT values. REAL and BLOB edits are intentionally not supported.

x-validationRules: The proposal is data only. No SQL statement, expression, WHERE clause or identifier supplied by the proposal is executed directly.
baseCatalogSha256 must equal the catalog bytes at validation time and again immediately before replacement. A stale proposal fails closed.
The key object must name exactly the live SQLite primary-key columns, using exact column spelling.
INSERT requires the key to be absent and merges key plus values; duplicate column names and conflicting key/value pairs are refused.
UPDATE and DELETE require expected values; the generated predicate includes both the primary key and expected values and exactly one row must match.
Primary-key columns cannot be changed by UPDATE.
catalog_meta, SQLite internal tables, cfg_LinksPageDirectory and any table or column forbidden by the package seal safety rules cannot be changed.
C9 V1 refuses REAL and BLOB cell edits. TEXT is encoded byte-exact as UTF-8 and INTEGER/bit values are invariant integers.

Dry-run never writes the catalog or baseline. Apply edits a same-volume temporary copy, validates SQLite integrity and foreign keys, writes an immutable baseline copy, rechecks the original SHA-256 and only then replaces the catalog.
The tool does not update or sign package-manifest.json. A successful edit is intentionally unsealed and must be followed by Seal-Package with the baseline and the production second-reader procedure.
